deals.evidence: Het Amerikaanse Orkila Capital verwerft 23,26% van de aandelen door 50 miljoen euro op tafel te leggen
deals.headline: Orkila Capital buys 23.26% of Club Brugge for EUR 50m
deals.seller: Existing shareholders (EUR 30m of shares) plus a EUR 20m capital increase
deals.summary: After Club Brugge called off its planned listing, US growth-equity fund Orkila Capital paid EUR 50m for 23.26%: EUR 20m in new capital and EUR 30m for shares bought from existing shareholders. Grizzly Sports NV, bundling Bart Verhaeghe, Vincent Mannaert, Jan Boone and Peter Vanhecke, kept 71.89%. Business AM put the implied value of the whole club at EUR 215m.

deals.evidence: Hij verkoopt zijn aandelen, die voorzitter Bart Verhaeghe verwerft.
deals.headline: Bart Verhaeghe buys out former CEO Vincent Mannaert's shares
deals.summary: Vincent Mannaert, CEO from 2011 to 2024, sold his shares to chairman Bart Verhaeghe and left the board. The shareholder structure with Orkila Capital, Dirk Van Tornhaut and the Tielt Connection alongside Grizzly Sports NV was unchanged. The price was not disclosed.

notes: Financials come from the filings at the National Bank of Belgium (Club Brugge NV, KBO 0460.444.251, year to 30 June 2025; the 2025-26 accounts were not filed by 3 Oct 2026). Revenue is statutory net turnover (omzet) of EUR 124.48m. Total operating income (bedrijfsopbrengsten) was EUR 176.90m, the 'EUR 177m' the press quotes, and includes EUR 52.4m of other operating income. The consolidated IFRS accounts show total operating income of EUR 154.196m, including EUR 31.658m of gains on player registrations, and EBITDA of EUR 53.067m. Revenue breakdown figures are in EUR thousands in the filing; text extraction of that PDF can space digits ('2 7.588'). Wages are total staff costs; the consolidated accounts give player and technical staff wages of EUR 48.075m. Net profit was EUR 18,099,821. Net debt is not stated as one figure, and the 2018 Belfius loan is debt, not stadium financing. Stakes: 71.89% and 23.26% were the July 2021 figures. Voetbalbelgie (Sept 2024) gives 73% and 23.6% after the December 2022 buyback and cancellation of 191,250 ordinary shares. Voetbalkrant reported that Mannaert held 13% and was paid an eight-figure sum; neither is officially confirmed. In May 2023 the Grizzly shareholders hired Raine Group to look for a buyer; Voetbalbelgie (Sept 2024) says those plans changed. The club's own site (clubbrugge.be) sits behind a bot check, so the history page is cited through its Wayback snapshot. The archived page counts 18 league titles to 2021-22 and predates the 2023-24 title, so honours are left null. Not found: attendance, shirt sponsor, kit supplier, social follower counts, and any valuation after 2021.

ownership_summary: Club Brugge NV is majority-owned by Grizzly Sports NV (73%), the holding of chairman Bart Verhaeghe (90.19% of Grizzly), Jan Boone's Stephenson (5.08%) and Peter Vanhecke's Vanhecke Consulting (4.73%). US growth-equity fund Orkila Capital has held a minority stake since July 2021 (23.26% at entry, 23.6% after a 2022 share buyback). The rest belongs to the 'Tielt Connection' (1.97%) and Dirk Van Tornhaut's Bluvn Goan (1.42%). Verhaeghe bought out former CEO Vincent Mannaert's shares in April 2024.
